_note: Which Claude model backs each hte.roles function (bkt-hte-self-accounting). Values are CLI model aliases, passed straight through to `claude -p --model`. `escalation` is not a role; hte.roles.extract reaches for it when its three-member ensemble disagrees above the agreement threshold in hte/roles.py's EXTRACT_AGREEMENT_THRESHOLD.
_timeouts_note: Per-role claude -p timeout override in seconds (hte.llm.resolve_timeout); a role with no entry here uses hte.llm.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S (300s). extractor is raised past the default: sacred-history-texts slices timed out twice in 422 calls at 300s (bkt-hte-extractor-timeout).
